# Scanlines

Darkened horizontal or vertical lines across the frame, hard or soft, optionally scrolling slowly. Scrolling stops when motion is off.

<EffectDemo effect="scanlines" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { scanlines } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/scanlines';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(scanlines({ preset: 'subtle' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.lineWidth = 3`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter     | Type                       | Default        | Range         | Description                             |
| ------------- | -------------------------- | -------------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `lineWidth`   | number                     | `3`            | 1 – 16 px     | Period of the lines.                    |
| `intensity`   | number                     | `0.35`         | 0 – 1         | How dark the lines are.                 |
| `softness`    | number                     | `0.6`          | 0 – 1         | Hard-edged (0) to sinusoidal (1) lines. |
| `speed`       | number                     | `0`            | -60 – 60 px/s | Scroll speed.                           |
| `orientation` | 'horizontal' \| 'vertical' | `'horizontal'` |               | Line direction.                         |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                                    |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `subtle`   | `intensity: 0.18`                                           |
| `arcade`   | `lineWidth: 4`, `intensity: 0.5`, `softness: 0.3`           |
| `rolling`  | `speed: 12`, `intensity: 0.3`                               |
| `vertical` | `orientation: 'vertical'`, `lineWidth: 3`, `intensity: 0.3` |

Apply one with `scanlines({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X7.3 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 4.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/scanlines`, including the shared effect runtime.
